map.均值 4.0 属良好，但若有维度≤2 会拉低可信度（本例数据准确性 3 虽>2: A mean of 4.0 is good, but any dimension at 2 or below drags down credibility (here data accuracy is 3, above 2 but still low). The point is to lift every dimension scoring 3 or below up to 4 or more, and above all to avoid any dimension at 2 or below.
map.均值 4.0 还要改吗？: Does a mean of 4.0 still need work?
map.用 5 维评分定位方案短板（任意维度≤2 自动标红「待改进」），指导迭代优化。: Use the five-dimension score to locate weaknesses in the plan (any dimension at 2 or below is flagged red as "needs improvement") to guide iterative optimisation.
map.科学性=依据是否前沿合理；全面性=是否覆盖关键指标；准确性=数据/算法误差大小；: Soundness = whether the basis is cutting edge and reasonable; completeness = whether key metrics are covered; accuracy = the size of data or algorithm error; professionalism = depth of interpretation; actionability = whether users can implement it. Together the five determine how credible the plan is.
